title: fix(plugin-security, spec): a create into a queue the caller is not in renders its own userMessage key
body:
Fixes #32341

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：用户新建记录时指定了自己不属于的队列而被拒，现在提示“请将队列留空或选择您所属的队列，或联系管理员”（新键 `errors.record_queue_assign_denied`，中英日西四语）；改动已有记录所在队列被拒，仍用原来那句“如需调整请联系管理员”。
- 为什么改：原来新建被拒也显示“如需移动请联系管理员”，可新建时并没有在移动记录，用户读到的下一步不对，也看不到真正能自助的办法。
- 风险与回滚：只换了新建这一处 403 的 `userMessage` 文案；状态码、`code`、`message`、`details` 一字未动，已在新建和修改两条路径、四种语言上逐字钉住。队列这句文案还没有发布过，没有部署覆盖会因此失效。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts`（两处 `denyQueueWrite` 调用各传哪个键）；`packages/spec/src/system/operation-message.ts`（四语新句）；`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/owner-queue-field-write-user-message.test.ts`（线上载荷钉子）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/owner-queue-field-write-user-message.test.ts`，预期 1 个文件、32 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Option (b): a separate create key at the insert site, under the one-wire-code, several-keys rule (#7451). Option (a), one sentence for both verbs, was rejected because the two refusals do not share a next step:

- the insert site (`isInsert` branch) admits a create into a queue for a **member** of that queue, so the user it refuses can leave the queue blank or pick a queue they belong to;
- the update site refuses **every** queue change without the transfer grant, whatever the caller's membership, so the only next step there is an administrator.

A single sentence would either offer the member remedy (wrong on the update: a member still cannot move a record) or drop it (the create user loses the step that actually works). The owner keys already split the same way (`record_owner_assign_denied` beside `record_owner_change_denied`).

Files:

- `packages/spec/src/system/operation-message.ts`: new catalog entry `record_queue_assign_denied` in en, zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES; key-table row for `record_queue_change_denied` reworded to an existing record's queue, new row for the create key; the jsdoc's placeholder-free list goes from four to five keys and says why the queue keys split by verb.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts`: `denyQueueWrite` takes the key; the insert site passes `record_queue_assign_denied`, the update site keeps `record_queue_change_denied`; the key union gains the new key. No predicate moved.
- Tests in both packages, and `.changeset/32341-queue-assign-denied-copy.md` (patch for `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/plugin-security`).

### The sentences, old and new, per locale

Create into a queue the caller is not in (`userMessage`):

| Locale | Old (`record_queue_change_denied`) | New (`record_queue_assign_denied`) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| en | You do not have permission to change which queue this record is in. Contact your administrator if it needs to be moved. | You do not have permission to create a record in that queue. Leave the queue blank or choose a queue you belong to, or contact your administrator. |
| zh-CN | 您无权更改这条记录所在的队列，如需调整请联系管理员。 | 您无权在该队列中创建记录，请将队列留空或选择您所属的队列，或联系管理员。 |
| ja-JP | このレコードのキューを変更する権限がありません。移動が必要な場合は管理者にお問い合わせください。 | 指定したキューにレコードを作成する権限がありません。キューを空欄にするか自分が所属するキューを選択するか、管理者にお問い合わせください。 |
| es-ES | No tiene permiso para cambiar la cola en la que está este registro. Póngase en contacto con su administrador si es necesario moverlo. | No tiene permiso para crear un registro en esa cola. Deje la cola vacía o elija una cola a la que pertenezca, o póngase en contacto con su administrador. |

Change of an existing record's queue: unchanged in all four locales (old = new = the `record_queue_change_denied` sentence in the left column above).

### What does not move

HTTP status (403), `code` (`PERMISSION_DENIED`), `message` (the `[Security]` template with `INSERT_QUEUE_REFUSAL` / `MOVE_REFUSAL`) and `details` (`operation`, `object`, `positions`, `permissionSets`) are byte-identical on both paths. A new describe block pins them per locale on the thrown refusal and on the REST data door body (`mapDataError`), for POST (create) and PATCH (update), and asserts every body member except `userMessage` is unchanged.
